description.shortText: A geothermal power-recycling plant that extracts CO2 from atmospheric air and transforms the resulting material into a byproduct. Able to generate byproducts, such as concrete, the raw materials produced can be sent to the market, thus establishing a circular carbon economy.

attachments.name: Capture Carbon in Concrete Made With CO2
A Swiss System Is Capturing Carbon Dioxide from the Air and Reselling It
attachments.description: Climeworks is capturing carbon dioxide with giant filters and, currently, pumping it into a greenhouse to help grow vegetables.

attachments.name: Bill Gates-Backed Carbon Capture Plant Does The Work Of 40 Million Trees
attachments.description: In Squamish, British Columbia, there’s a company that wants to stop climate change by sucking carbon dioxide out of the atmosphere. It’s called Carbon Engine.

attachments.name: UK's biggest carbon capture project is step-change on emissions
attachments.description: Tata-owned Cheshire plant to turn 40,000 tonnes of CO2 a year into useful products

attachments.name: How Bill Gates aims to clean up the planet
attachments.description: The idea is grandiose yet simple: decarbonise the global economy by extracting global-warming carbon dioxide (CO2) straight from the air, using arrays of giant fans and patented chemical whizzery; and then use the gas to make clean, carbon-neutral synthetic diesel and petrol to drive the world’s ships, planes and trucks.

attachments.name: New carbon capture technique developed for power plants
attachments.description: A new development in carbon capture technology could provide an efficient and inexpensive way for natural gas power plants to remove carbon dioxide (CO2) from flue emissions, a necessary step to reduce greenhouse gas emissions.

attachments.name: World’s First Commercial CO2 Capture Plant Goes Live.
attachments.description: The world's first commercial direct carbon capture plant is set to begin operations this week in Switzerland.

attachments.name: The exhaust gas from a power plant can be recovered and used as a raw reaction material
attachments.description: A research group developed a new technology that can drastically conserve the energy used to capture CO2 from gases exhausted from a concentrated source such as thermal power plants. With this technology, namely H2 stripping regeneration technology, combustion exhaust gas can be replaced by CO2/H2 gas at lower temperatures than those used in conventional technology.

attachments.name: Coal industry stakes survival on carbon capture plan
attachments.description: A looming government clampdown on CO2 emissions is about to confront an already embattled U.S. coal power industry with two stark options: capture carbon or die.

attachments.name: Global Carbon Dioxide Emissions Set New Record
attachments.description: In April of this year, the Mauna Loa Observatory in Hawaii recorded an average concentration of atmospheric carbon dioxide above 410 parts per million (ppm). This was the highest monthly average in recorded history, and in fact according to ice core records it is the highest value in at least 800,000 years.
